verdict.rationale: Wrike's own AI features, Copilot summarizing work, AI content generation and AI insights over work data, plausibly cover drafting a summary from project activity. However, no evidence describes a dedicated AI-drafted project or initiative status update built from recent activity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated project/initiative status updates, evidence that drafts are built from recent activity rather than general summaries, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: Wrike Copilot answers questions, summarizes work, and keeps your team moving
AI Essentials include AI content and editing, comment summary
Wrike AI insights turn raw work data into clear, actionable intelligence.
